notes: Recumbent delta e-trike (Germany). Maker page is the EU English site: price in euros only ('from 8.600,–'), no top speed, class or range. EP6 Cargo config (ONE / ONE UP) is 85 Nm, 630 Wh, Inter-5E Di2; the ONE PLUS uses Bosch Performance Line CX. US dealer New Wheel lists 'Hase Kettwiesel One' at $10,210 but describes a Shimano E6100 60Nm / Alfine 8 base config with 85 Nm and 630 Wh options, so its price was not recorded. Fold: Hase says it folds down for transport (boom shortens, seatback and handlebar fold) - judge whether that counts as a folding frame. Max load 140 kg is labelled 'max. load' without saying total vs payload. | recheck: looked for a US class / mph on hasebikes.com (incl. hidden text), RAD Innovations, Hostel Shoppe, Laid Back Cycles, Utah Trikes (404) and 1 WebSearch: no page states a class or a US top speed.
